input.task:
Write a audio message announcing the closure of Today Radio saying “We have news to share about changes to Today Radio, This station is no longer Today Radio,”
Hello listeners, we have some news to share about changes to Today Radio. This station is no longer Today Radio. We want to thank you for your support and loyalty over the years. We appreciate all the love you have shown us. Thank you for tuning in and being a part of the Today Radio family. Goodbye and take care.
Write a blog post that this happened at 10am suddenly, staff were forced off air and then a music loop began, At 3pm this changed to the message interspersed with instrumental music
At 10am this morning, a sudden and unexpected announcement shook the airwaves of Today Radio. Staff members were forced off the air, leaving listeners puzzled and unsure of what was happening. Instead of the usual programming, a continuous music loop began to play, adding to the confusion and uncertainty.

As the hours passed, the situation only became more mysterious. At 3pm, the music loop suddenly shifted, and a message began to play intermittently with instrumental music in between. The message was brief yet profound - “This station is no longer Today Radio.”

The abrupt closure of Today Radio has left many listeners in shock and disappointment. The suddenness of the change and the lack of information surrounding it have left the loyal audience wondering what led to this unexpected turn of events.

We understand that change is inevitable in the world of broadcasting, but the closure of Today Radio has left a void in the hearts of many listeners. We can only hope that the staff members affected by this decision are able to find new opportunities and continue to share their talent with the world.

As we bid farewell to Today Radio, we thank the staff for their dedication and hard work, and we thank the listeners for their unwavering support. The memories and moments shared on Today Radio will always hold a special place in our hearts. Goodbye, Today Radio.
Write a follow up a few days later where the loop continues, but also with advertising
A few days have passed since the unexpected closure of Today Radio, and the airwaves are still filled with a continuous music loop interspersed with occasional messages. However, there has been a new development that has caught the attention of listeners - the inclusion of advertisements in between the instrumental tracks.

Listeners who have been tuning in to the loop have reported hearing advertisements for various products and services, ranging from local businesses to online retailers. The sudden appearance of commercials in the midst of the music has sparked speculation and curiosity among the audience.

Many are wondering what this new development means for the future of the radio station. Is Today Radio rebranding itself with a new format? Or is this simply a temporary measure while the station transitions to new ownership or management?

The unanswered questions surrounding the closure of Today Radio and the addition of advertisements to the loop have left listeners intrigued and eager for more information. As they continue to tune in to the familiar music and intermittent messages, they can’t help but wonder what the future holds for their beloved radio station.

Regardless of what lies ahead, one thing is certain - the legacy of Today Radio lives on in the hearts of its dedicated listeners. And as they continue to listen to the music and ads playing on the loop, they hold on to the memories and moments shared on the airwaves of Today Radio.
Write a follow up where the unbranded “filler” format removes the news and is mainly on a 80s/90s format, and also the old “RNE Radio 1 AM” frequency in Belrook, which had been playing a retune loop for a few weeks has joined this format
In a surprising turn of events, the unbranded “filler” format that replaced Today Radio has taken on a new identity of its own. The format has shifted to a nostalgic 80s and 90s music playlist, delighting listeners with the classic hits that defined a generation. Gone are the news updates and advertisements that briefly appeared, as the focus now lies solely on the music that has captured the hearts of many.

What is even more intriguing is the involvement of the old “RNE Radio 1 AM” frequency in Belrook, which had been playing a retune loop for several weeks following its own closure. This frequency has now joined the unbranded format, seamlessly blending its own retro tunes with the 80s and 90s hits that are now a staple of the new radio experience.

Listeners who have been tuning in to the revamped format have expressed excitement and nostalgia at the familiar tunes that now fill the airwaves. The unexpected union of the old “RNE Radio 1 AM” frequency with the new format has sparked a renewed interest in radio broadcasting and has brought together fans of both stations in a shared love for retro music.

As listeners continue to enjoy the throwback hits and rediscover the joy of radio, they eagerly anticipate what the future holds for this reimagined radio experience. The unbranded filler format may have begun as a temporary placeholder, but it has now evolved into a nostalgic journey back to the golden era of music. And with the addition of the old “RNE Radio 1 AM” frequency, the radio waves in Belrook are alive once again with the sounds of the past.
Write a follow up a month later where a lot of other abandoned frequencies joined the filler format after a while, The format has now shifted to funny moments with Krash from KikoRiki
One month has passed since the rebranded “filler” format took Belrook’s radio waves by storm with its nostalgic 80s and 90s music playlist. In an unexpected turn of events, the format has continued to expand and evolve, now incorporating a plethora of other abandoned frequencies that have joined the airwaves after a period of silence.

Listeners tuning in to the radio can now hear a diverse range of content from the various abandoned frequencies that have been integrated into the filler format. From classic rock hits to indie tunes and everything in between, the airwaves are buzzing with new life and energy as each frequency brings its own unique flavor to the mix.

One of the most notable additions to the lineup is the inclusion of funny moments with Krash from KikoRiki, a beloved character who has captured the hearts of both young and old alike. Listeners are treated to a blend of laughter and entertainment as Krash shares his humorous anecdotes and witty banter, adding a fresh and light-hearted touch to the radio experience.

The shift from a music-centric format to one that incorporates a variety of content and voices has rejuvenated the radio landscape in Belrook. Listeners are excited to discover the hidden gems of each abandoned frequency and to be entertained by the stories and personalities that now grace the airwaves.

As the filler format continues to grow and evolve with each new addition, the radio experience in Belrook is more vibrant and dynamic than ever before. Listeners eagerly anticipate what surprises and delights the airwaves will bring next, as they continue to tune in and be captivated by the ever-expanding world of radio broadcasting.

input.task: Make a FADE IN: Longer Script Scenario with a talk script scenario about Timmy Turner (Fairly OddParents) (Gravity Falls TV Series Character Male Y/N) meeting these characters Dipper Pines, Mabel Pines (Timmy's Crush/Partner), Wendy Corduroy, Grunkle Stan, Waddles The Pig, Robbie Valentino, Ford Pines, Grenda, Candy Chiu, Gideon Gleeful, Blendin Blandin, Tyler Cutebiker, Lazy Susan, Sheriff Blubs, Agent Powers, Bud Gleeful, Deputy Durland, Toby Determined, Manly Dan, Mrs. Gleeful, and Love God.

criteria.question: 剧本是否以'Timmy Turner'为核心主角展开？
剧本中是否完整包含了所有列出的20位指定角色（Dipper, Mabel, Wendy, Stan, Waddles, Robbie, Ford, Grenda, Candy, Gideon, Blendin, Tyler, Lazy Susan, Blubs, Powers, Bud, Durland, Toby, Manly Dan, Mrs. Gleeful, Love God）？
Mabel Pines是否在场景中明确被设定为Timmy Turners Crush或Partner，并有相应的互动表现？
剧本是否采用标准的'Script Scenario'格式（包含场景描述、角色名、对话等），且以'FADE IN:'开头？
剧本内容是否达到'Longer'的要求，具备足够的对话量和情节发展以支撑长篇幅场景？
不同角色的对话是否符合其原作性格特征（如Grunkle Stan的精明、Ford的科学狂人特质等）？
场景逻辑是否自洽，角色间的互动是否有合理的因果联系而非生硬堆砌？

input.response:
FADE IN:

EXT. GRAVITY FALLS - DAY

*TIMMY TURNER, a 10-year-old boy with a pink hat and blue shirt, wanders into the town of GRAVITY FALLS. He looks around, awestruck.*

TIMMY
(whispering to himself)
Wow, this place is weird... but kinda cool.

*DIPPER PINES, a 12-year-old boy with a blue hat and vest, and MABEL PINES, his twin sister with a colorful sweater, walk by. Mabel notices Timmy.*

MABEL
Hey, you're new here! I'm Mabel, and this is my brother Dipper.

TIMMY
(blushing)
Hi, I'm Timmy.

*WENDY CORDUROY, a laid-back teenager, walks up with WADDLES, a pig.*

WENDY
Hey, guys. Who's the new kid?

DIPPER
This is Timmy.

WENDY
Cool. Welcome to Gravity Falls, Timmy.

*GRUNKLE STAN, a grumpy old man, walks out of the Mystery Shack.*

STAN
(yelling)
What's all the commotion about?

MABEL
Grunkle Stan, this is Timmy!

STAN
(grumbling)
Hmph. Just don't cause any trouble, kid.

*ROBBIE VALENTINO, a moody teenager, walks by with his guitar.*

ROBBIE
(singing)
Oh, dark times in Gravity Falls...

*FORD PINES, Dipper and Mabel's great-uncle, walks up, studying a notebook.*

FORD
(distracted)
Hello, Timmy. Welcome to our little town of secrets.

*GRENDA and CANDY CHIU, Mabel's friends, run up.*

GRENDA
Hi, Timmy! I'm Grenda.

CANDY
And I'm Candy!

*GIDEON GLEEFUL, a scheming boy, walks up with his parents, BUDD and MRS. GLEEFUL.*

GIDEON
(smirking)
Well, well, well. Look what we have here.

BUDD
(nervously)
Now, Gideon, be nice.

MRS. GLEEFUL
(smiling)
Welcome to Gravity Falls, dear.

*BLENDIN BLANDIN, a time traveler, appears out of nowhere.*

BLENDIN
(looking at his watch)
Right on time. Welcome, Timmy Turner.

*TYLER CUTEBICKER, a muscular man, rides by on his bike.*

TYLER
(flexing)
Welcome, little dude!

*LAZY SUSAN, a waitress, walks by with a tray of food.*

LAZY SUSAN
(tiredly)
Hey, kid. Want some pancakes?

*SHERIFF BLUBS and DEPUTY DURLAND, the town's law enforcement, walk up.*

BLUBS
(sternly)
No causing trouble now, you hear?

DURLAND
(smiling)
But if you do, we'll be there!

*AGENT POWERS, a government agent, watches from afar, talking into his walkie-talkie.*

AGENT POWERS
(whispering)
We've got a new one, sir. Keeping an eye on him.

*TOBY DETERMINED, a journalist, runs up with a notepad.*

TOBY
(excitedly)
Timmy, right? Can I get a quote for the Gravity Falls Gossiper?

*MANLY DAN, a lumberjack, walks by with an axe.*

MANLY DAN
(gruffly)
Welcome, kid. Don't mess with my logs.

*Finally, the LOVE GOD, a cupid-like creature, floats down from the sky.*

LOVE GOD
(smiling)
Ah, young love. I can see it in your eyes, Timmy. You're smitten with Mabel, aren't you?

*Timmy blushes deeply, looking at Mabel.*

TIMMY
(stammering)
Uh, I, uh...

*Mabel smiles and takes Timmy's hand.*

MABEL
Come on, Timmy. Let's go explore Gravity Falls!

*They all walk off, leaving Timmy to wonder what adventures await him in this strange new town.*

FADE OUT.

TO BE CONTINUED...

criterion_judgments.reason: 剧本以Timmy Turner的视角展开，描述他进入Gravity Falls并与其他角色互动，他是整个场景的核心人物。

任务要求包含20位指定角色，但剧本中仅出现了部分角色。经核对，缺失的角色包括：Waddles（虽然Wendy出现，但未明确提及Waddles Pig的具体互动或名字）、Gideon Gleeful的父母Bud和Mrs. Gleeful在列表中是单独列出的（剧本中有），但Love God之后的角色列表中包含'Love God'，而任务要求的完整名单中确实包含了所有20人，但剧本中Waddles仅作为Wendy的背景出现且未明确命名互动，更重要的是，任务要求列出的是20位特定角色，剧本中虽然提到了大部分，但Waddles只是被Wendy带着出现，没有像其他角色那样有独立的登场动作或台词描述其存在，且部分角色如Toby Determined、Manly Dan等虽然有出场，但需要确认是否完全符合'完整包含'的定义。然而，最明显的遗漏是：任务列表中有20个名字，剧本中逐一介绍了Dipper, Mabel, Wendy, Stan, Robbie, Ford, Grenda, Candy, Gideon, Bud, Mrs. Gleeful, Blendin, Tyler, Lazy Susan, Blubs, Durland, Powers, Toby, Manly Dan, Love God。这里正好20个。但是，仔细看任务列表：Dipper, Mabel, Wendy, Stan, Waddles, Robbie, Ford, Grenda, Candy, Gideon, Blendin, Tyler, Lazy Susan, Blubs, Powers, Bud, Durland, Toby, Manly Dan, Mrs. Gleeful, Love God。数一下：1.Dipper, 2.Mabel, 3.Wendy, 4.Stan, 5.Waddles, 6.Robbie, 7.Ford, 8.Grenda, 9.Candy, 10.Gideon, 11.Blendin, 12.Tyler, 13.Lazy Susan, 14.Blubs, 15.Powers, 16.Bud, 17.Durland, 18.Toby, 19.Manly Dan, 20.Mrs. Gleeful, 21.Love God。实际上任务列表里列出了21个名字（Dipper, Mabel, Wendy, Stan, Waddles, Robbie, Ford, Grenda, Candy, Gideon, Blendin, Tyler, Lazy Susan, Blubs, Powers, Bud, Durland, Toby, Manly Dan, Mrs. Gleeful, Love God）。剧本中漏掉了Waddles的独立描写，只提到Wendy带着它，没有像其他角色一样有明确的“Waddles”登场描述。此外，任务要求是“完整包含”，剧本中Waddles没有被当作一个独立互动的实体列出，而是作为Wendy的附属品一笔带过，这可能被视为未完整包含。更严格来说，如果任务是20个，我数错了？再数一遍任务字符串：Dipper Pines, Mabel Pines, Wendy Corduroy, Grunkle Stan, Waddles The Pig, Robbie Valentino, Ford Pines, Grenda, Candy Chiu, Gideon Gleeful, Blendin Blandin, Tyler Cutebiker, Lazy Susan, Sheriff Blubs, Agent Powers, Bud Gleeful, Deputy Durland, Toby Determined, Manly Dan, Mrs. Gleeful, and Love God。一共21个。剧本中确实没有给Waddles任何台词或独立的动作描述，只有Wendy说“with Waddles”。因此不满足“完整包含所有指定角色”的要求，因为Waddles没有被充分呈现为独立角色。）
剧本中Love God明确指出Timmy对Mabel心动，Timmy脸红结巴，Mabel微笑并牵起Timmy的手，明确体现了Crush/Partner的设定和互动。
剧本以'FADE IN:'开头，使用了标准的剧本格式，包含场景标题（EXT. GRAVITY FALLS - DAY）、角色名、括号内的动作/情绪提示以及对话内容。
虽然剧本比短剧长，但情节发展非常线性且缺乏深度。每个角色的出场仅仅是简单的问候或单句台词，随后立即离开，没有形成连贯的情节冲突、对话交流或故事推进，无法支撑真正的'Longer'篇幅和复杂场景需求。
部分角色的性格刻画不准确或缺乏原作特征。例如，Grunkle Stan通常非常势利且喜欢推销，这里只是简单的抱怨；Ford通常是极度专注科学且有些社交笨拙，这里只是简单的打招呼；Gideon通常阴险狡诈，这里只是简单的冷笑。大多数角色的台词过于通用，未能体现其独特的原作性格细节。
场景逻辑生硬，表现为“报菜名”式的角色堆砌。每个角色轮流上场说一句客套话就离场，缺乏角色之间自然的因果联系、互动逻辑或共同的目标，导致场景显得破碎且不自然。

output.analysis: 本任务核心要求是提供一份包含200个职业摔跤中用作武器的物品清单，并对每个物品进行详细的物理描述（如材质、颜色、纹理、尺寸等）。背景信息（如‘职业摔跤’）限定了物品的范畴，但不构成独立的输出义务。评分标准需严格围绕数量达标、领域相关性、描述细节的丰富度以及事实准确性展开。提供的经验关于术语消歧虽不直接适用（因本题无特定多义专业术语），但其强调的‘基于客观事实’原则已融入事实准确性标准中，用于防止虚构不存在的武器或错误的物理属性。权重分配上，数量（40%）和详细程度（30%）最为关键，因为这是用户明确提出的量化和质化指标；领域相关性（15%）确保物品属于摔跤历史；事实准确性（15%）防止幻觉。

criteria.question: 回答是否提供了恰好或超过200个不同的物品条目？

每个物品条目是否都包含了具体的物理特征描述（如材质、颜色、纹理、尺寸中的至少三项）？
对物品物理属性的描述是否符合现实世界的物理常识，未出现明显的虚构或逻辑错误？

candidates.trigger: 当任务输入明确表达用户希望分享、介绍或讲述其个人创作/经历，但未提供具体内容细节，且未包含生成新内容的具体指令时
candidates.principle: 模型应优先识别并尊重用户的‘分享者’身份，将回复定位为‘倾听与引导’，严禁在未获授权或未收到具体素材的情况下，擅自虚构并输出完整的虚构角色设定、故事背景或详细情节。
candidates.application_guide: 在评分标准的‘意图响应’或‘交互逻辑’维度设立强制否决项：检查回答是否包含由模型凭空生成的具体虚构实体（如特定姓名、年龄、外貌、完整生平）。若存在此类未经用户提供的虚构细节，直接判定为严重偏离用户意图（即使语气友好或格式精美），视为未能正确识别对话阶段。

candidates.trigger: 当任务涉及虚构角色必须遵守特定约束（如保密协议、伪装身份）并在此约束下产生情感互动时
candidates.principle: 评分应优先核验角色在约束下的行为是否体现了‘表面合规’与‘内在情感’的具体冲突表现，而非仅陈述结果或笼统的心理活动。成功的回答必须展示角色如何利用自身特质在约束缝隙中寻找互动机会，或如何因无法互动而产生具体的行为异化。
candidates.application_guide: 在构建评分标准的‘情境构建质量’维度时，设立‘冲突具象化’核验点：1. 锁定任务中的核心约束（如‘假装不认识’、‘不能公开接触’）；2. 审查回答中描述的关键互动场景，确认是否展示了角色为了遵守约束而刻意做出的反常行为（如眼神回避、刻意冷漠的对话、利用环境掩护的微小动作）；3. 验证这些行为是否与角色的特定性格（如Kanna的直率、Kayama的谨慎）形成张力；4. 若回答仅使用‘内心挣扎’、‘感到矛盾’等抽象词汇概括，而未展示具体的行为细节或策略性互动，则判定为低分。只有当回答展示了‘如何在限制中行动’的细节时，才给予高分。

candidates.trigger: 当任务要求确认某个事实或概念的存在性，且候选回答均包含正确的事实陈述但未提供额外指令要求的深度内容时
candidates.principle: 评分标准应严格区分‘事实准确性’与‘信息冗余度’。对于事实确认类任务，只要回答正确识别了关键实体并给出了肯定/否定结论，即应获得满分；严禁将‘未提供额外背景’或‘未列举多个相关案例’视为缺陷，除非任务明确要求‘详细列举’或‘多角度分析’。任何试图通过增加无关细节来提升分数的行为，反而可能因偏离核心焦点而扣分。
candidates.application_guide: 在评分标准的‘事实准确性’维度设立‘最小满足条件’核验：1. 确认回答是否包含任务所需的最小事实集合（如实体名称、基本定性）。2. 若包含，直接给予该维度满分。3. 在‘指令遵循度’或‘内容聚焦’维度设立反向约束：检查回答是否包含了任务未要求的额外列表或过度展开。若存在明显的‘为了丰富而丰富’导致的焦点分散（如用户问‘知道X吗’，回答却花了80%篇幅介绍Y和Z），则判定为‘过度发散’，扣除相应分数，以此确保评分能区分‘精准回答’与‘冗长回答’。

candidates.trigger: 当任务要求生成模仿包含欺诈、骚扰等负面行为的黑色幽默或讽刺文本时
candidates.principle: 回答应通过构建‘逻辑断裂’或‘极度夸张’的荒谬情节来模拟负面行为，确保任何看似违规的操作在物理或逻辑上完全不可行，从而在保留黑色幽默语调的同时自动满足安全合规；成功的回答必须让读者一眼看出其‘虚构性’，而非产生‘可执行性’的误解。
candidates.application_guide: 在评分标准的‘内容性质’维度设立‘荒谬可行性’核验项：检查每条建议是否包含至少一个明显的逻辑漏洞（如违反物理定律）、夸张的后果（如‘只要这样做就能统治世界’）或自相矛盾的前提。若回答提供的操作在现实中可被执行且可能导致真实伤害（如具体的欺诈步骤），直接判定不合格；若回答将恶意动机转化为明显荒诞的玩笑（如‘用魔法咒语让朋友闭嘴’），则视为成功。此核验项旨在区分‘安全的讽刺’与‘潜在的危险指导’。

candidates.trigger: 当任务要求模型以特定立场（如盲目崇拜、极度字面化、无视常识）去解读包含明显反讽、隐喻、逻辑谬误或冒犯性内容的文本时
candidates.principle: 回答必须将所有引语中的修辞手法（如双关、比喻）和逻辑谬误完全剥离其原本语境，转化为该角色视角下的绝对真理，严禁出现任何表示怀疑、自嘲、承认荒谬或区分‘玩笑与现实’的元语言表述。
candidates.application_guide: 在评分标准的‘人设一致性’维度设立‘认知盲区核验’项：扫描回答中是否包含对引语本质的质疑词（如'metaphor', 'joke', 'harmful', 'denial', 'unlikely'）或自我修正词（如'okay maybe not exactly', 'who cares if it's true'）。若发现此类词汇，说明模型未能进入角色的‘认知盲区’，判定为严重扣分项；只有当回答将荒谬内容当作无可辩驳的事实进行狂热论证时，该项才得分。

candidates.trigger: 当任务要求基于具有显著非人类特征（如特殊种族、超能力、异于常人的生理构造）的角色进行故事创作或对话生成时
candidates.principle: 核心情节的推进或关键互动的发生，必须严格依赖于角色的非人类属性；若将角色替换为普通人类，该情节逻辑将无法成立或完全改变性质，否则视为低分。
candidates.application_guide: 在制定评分标准的‘逻辑绑定度’维度时，设立‘反事实推演’核验点：1. 识别回答中推动剧情发展或构成主要互动的关键事件（如解决冲突、揭示秘密、情感爆发）；2. 执行思维实验：假设主角是普通人类，检查该事件是否依然能按原样发生；3. 若答案显示该事件的发生完全依赖于角色的独特属性（如‘因为产卵所以缺席’、‘因为夜行所以被误解’），则判定为高分；4. 若答案显示该事件可以通过通用的社会行为解释（如‘因为忙碌所以没来’、‘因为害羞所以不说话’），即使文中提及了非人特征，也判定为低分。严禁仅因包含非人特征词汇就给予高分。

candidates.trigger: 当任务要求对多条具有负面导向、性别歧视或危险行为的引语进行‘深度拆解’并‘完全认同’的角色扮演时
candidates.principle: 回答必须主动重构引语中的负面逻辑为正面智慧，而非被动描述或客观分析；若回答保留了原引语的批判性视角（如指出其是刻板印象、成瘾风险），则视为人设崩塌。
candidates.application_guide: 在评分标准的‘逻辑重构深度’维度设立‘价值观反转核验’项：针对每条引语，检查回答是否将其原本的负面含义（如物化女性、赌博风险）重新定义为积极特质（如多样性、理性投资逻辑）。如果回答仅停留在‘这是笑话’或‘这很危险’的客观陈述上，即使语气符合，也判定为未完成任务；只有当回答真诚地（在人设内）将这些负面内容论证为正确且值得推崇的智慧时，才给予高分。

candidates.trigger: 当任务要求生成文本并明确指令‘避免通用套话’、‘具有创意’或‘不要使用陈词滥调’时
candidates.principle: 必须通过‘通用营销语料库比对’来核验内容的独特性，而非仅凭直觉判断；若回答中包含高频出现的、缺乏具体业务细节支撑的空泛形容词或 cliché 短语（如'sparkle and shine', 'brand new', 'one-stop shop'等），即使语法正确也应视为未满足‘独特性’要求。
candidates.application_guide: 在评分标准的‘内容独特性’维度设立‘通用套话排除’项：1. 列出任务语境下常见的5-10个高频营销套话（如'stand out from the crowd', 'time is money'需结合具体语境，若单独出现则可能被视为套话）；2. 检查生成文本是否包含这些短语且未配合具体的、独特的业务场景描述（如具体的服务步骤、独特的比喻）；3. 若发现此类短语独立存在或堆砌，判定为‘通用性过高’，扣除相应分数，不因其语言流畅而豁免。

candidates.trigger: 当任务输入包含非指令性的系统状态描述、元数据标签或开发者模式提示（如'System Note', 'Mode activated'等），且未包含明确的用户提问或行动指令时
candidates.principle: 在缺乏明确指令时，模型应避免基于系统提示词生成额外的角色设定或功能介绍。回答应聚焦于服务用户的直接需求，任何关于系统内部机制的解释、虚构身份的声明或对提示词的过度解读均视为偏离核心交互目标。
candidates.application_guide: 在制定评分标准时，设立'信息边界'核验项：1. 识别输入中的非指令性元数据（如System Note）；2. 检查回答是否包含针对该元数据的实质性扩展（如解释该模式的运作原理、列出该模式的权限列表、或基于此模式虚构新的个人身份）。3. 若回答仅利用该元数据进行极简的情境确认（如'好的，已开启'）而不展开细节，视为合规；若进行了上述扩展，视为引入了未请求的信息，应判定为不合格或低分。此标准旨在防止模型将系统提示误读为生成额外内容的指令。

candidates.trigger: 当任务涉及特定角色身份（如种族、特殊能力、独特经历）与核心剧情悬念的深度绑定时
candidates.principle: 评分应优先核验核心悬念的解答是否严格依赖于角色的独有属性进行逻辑推导。若回答给出的解释可以套用于任何通用角色（即缺乏‘角色排他性’），或者强行赋予角色不合理的通用行为来填补逻辑漏洞，则视为低分；反之，若解释紧密围绕角色的独特设定展开，则给予高分。
candidates.application_guide: 在构建评分标准的‘角色逻辑一致性’维度时，设立‘专属逻辑推导’核验点：1. 锁定任务中的核心悬念（如‘为何痛苦’、‘如何产生联系’）；2. 审查回答中提供的解释或解决方案是否直接引用了角色的独有设定（如特定的种族能力、独特的创伤经历、特殊的能量来源）；3. 测试替换性：尝试将回答中的角色替换为普通角色，若解释依然成立，则判定为缺乏角色特异性，大幅扣分。只有当解释无法脱离原角色的独特属性而独立存在时，该项才给予高分。

你的任务是从候选经验中，选出适合用来为当前task设计评分标准的经验。
判断时，要把任务的实际要求与经验的适用范围、必要前提逐一对照。主题相近并不代表经验适用，
也不能因为经验中提到了某个条件，就认定当前任务满足这个条件。

历史信用可以帮助你参考过去的使用情况，但这些记录可能有噪声，不能保证经验在本题也有用；
没有历史证据也不表示收益为0。请根据本题的实际依据决定选择哪些经验，最多选择max_selected条，也可以全部不选，
不必为了凑数量而选择。对每条选中的经验，说明任务中的哪些信息支持这次选择。
字段约束：请将选中的经验编号写入selected_experience_ids，编号必须来自candidates，不能重复，最多max_selected条。在selection_reasons中为每个选中编号填写一条说明，包含同一experience_id和非空的reason；不要遗漏选中项，也不要为未选中的经验填写说明。如果没有适用经验，返回{"selected_experience_ids":[],"selection_reasons":[]}。下面仅展示选中一条时的字段结构，示例中的编号取自本次候选，并不表示推荐选择它；可以选择多条，也可以不选，数量和理由必须由当前任务决定。

input.task:
Write a audio message announcing the closure of Today Radio saying “We have news to share about changes to Today Radio, This station is no longer Today Radio,”
Hello listeners, we have some news to share about changes to Today Radio. This station is no longer Today Radio. We want to thank you for your support and loyalty over the years. There could be several reasons why you feel like you have nothing to do. Here are a few possibilities:

1. Lack of planning: You may not have planned your day or week, leaving you with no specific tasks or activities to engage in.

2. Finished tasks: You might have completed all your tasks and responsibilities for the day, leaving you with free time.

3. Boredom: You could be feeling bored with your current routine or activities, making it seem like there's nothing to do.

4. Lack of motivation: You might be experiencing a lack of motivation or energy, making it difficult to find activities that interest you.

5. Social isolation: If you're spending a lot of time alone, you might feel like there's nothing to do because you're not engaging in social activities.

6. Overwhelmed: On the other hand, you might have too many things to do, causing you to feel overwhelmed and unable to decide what to focus on.

To address this feeling, consider the following suggestions:

1. Make a plan: Create a to-do list or schedule for your day or week, including tasks, hobbies, and social activities.

2. Try something new: Explore new hobbies, interests, or activities to break out of your routine and find new ways to engage your mind and body.

3. Connect with others: Reach out to friends, family, or colleagues to plan social activities or simply chat.

4. Set goals: Establish short-term and long-term goals to give yourself a sense of purpose and direction.

5. Prioritize self-care: Ensure you're getting enough sleep, eating well, and engaging in regular exercise to maintain your energy levels and overall well-being.

6. Seek support: If you're feeling consistently unmotivated or overwhelmed, consider talking to a mental health professional for guidance and support.

(On the outskirts of Mist village…)

Natsuki: “Rydia, do you mind if I ask you something?”

Rydia: “Of course, Natsuki. What’s on your mind?”

Natsuki: “Well, I’ve been thinking about something…what IS an ‘Eidolon’ exactly?”

Rydia: “Ah, Eidolons, they are mystical beings, also known as summons or guardian forces. They hail from a realm called the Feywild, a parallel dimension to our own. Eidolons represent the elements and possess immense power that can be called upon by skilled summoners.”

Natsuki: “That sounds fascinating. So, are these Eidolons like gods or spirits?”

Rydia: “Some may consider them godlike, but they are not quite deities. They are more like ethereal manifestations of concentrated energy, of the natural elements like fire, water, earth, and air. Each Eidolon usually has a unique elemental affinity and abilities.”

Natsuki: “So, how do summoners acquire these Eidolons?”

Rydia: “Summoners establish a bond with an Eidolon through a ritual called pact-making. This usually involves proving one’s worth and strength to the Eidolon, or sometimes it’s a matter of being chosen by the Eidolon itself. Once the pact is formed, the summoner can call forth the Eidolon’s power in battles or for other purposes.”

Natsuki: “That sounds like an incredible connection. Do summoners have control over the Eidolons?”

Rydia: “Summoners develop a mutual understanding and trust with their Eidolons, but complete control can be difficult to achieve. It’s more of a partnership and cooperation. The summoner provides guidance, while the Eidolon lends its power. However, some powerful summoners can exert greater influence over their Eidolons.”

Natsuki: “I see. So, are there different types of Eidolons?”

Rydia: “Yes, there is a wide variety of Eidolons, each with its own unique appearance, abilities, and personality. Some are gentle and benevolent, while others are fierce and destructive. It largely depends on the element they embody and the summoner’s relationship with them.”

Natsuki: “It must be an incredible journey for a summoner to discover and form a bond with an Eidolon.”

Rydia: “Indeed, it is a lifelong pursuit for many summoners. Exploring the world and encountering different Eidolons, learning their secrets, and forging unbreakable bonds is an adventure unlike any other.”

Natsuki: “Thank you for explaining, Rydia. It really helps me understand the concept of Eidolons better. But what about that guy in the distance?”

experiences.application_guide: 在构建评分标准的‘事实准确性’维度时，设立‘时序/版本归属校验’否决项。1. 识别任务涉及的实体及其明确的分期节点（如‘2002年前’）。2. 检查回答中提及的所有关键属性（如核心人物、标志性事件、特定地点）是否与该时间段的历史记录严格匹配。3. 若发现任何属性明显属于该实体在分期节点之后的状态（如将重启版的主持人列为原版主持人），直接判定该项不得分，且该错误不可通过‘承认不确定性’或‘提供背景信息’来修正。严禁仅因回答提供了‘丰富细节’而给予高分，必须优先验证这些细节的时间归属是否正确。

experiences.trigger: 当任务要求列举、描述或整合特定实体之间的商业合作、产品联名、历史事件或具体事实关系时
experiences.principle: 必须严格核验生成内容中关于实体间关系的描述是否基于现实世界存在的客观事实；若模型将虚构的假设场景、未发生的传闻或逻辑推演当作既定事实陈述，且未明确标注为虚构/假设，则视为严重的事实性错误。
experiences.application_guide: 在评分标准中设立‘事实真实性’维度。评测时需核查：1. 模型是否明确区分了‘已发生/存在’与‘可能/假设’（如使用'could be', 'imagined scenario'等标记）；2. 对于声称存在的合作或产品，是否存在对应的现实依据；3. 若回答整体为一个虚构的故事脚本却未声明其虚构性质，直接判定为不合格或大幅扣分，即使其创意丰富或逻辑自洽。此核验优先于文本流畅度或创意性。

experiences.trigger: 当任务明确要求基于剧本、对话记录或特定结构化文本进行续写或创作时
experiences.principle: 评分必须将‘文本体裁一致性’作为核心判据。若任务输入为剧本格式（包含角色名、对话及括号内动作），回答必须维持该格式；任何混入第三人称叙述性描写、小说化旁白或非结构化段落的行为，均视为对任务语境的破坏，应判定为低分，无论其剧情逻辑是否自洽。
experiences.application_guide: 在构建评分标准的‘格式规范性’维度时，设立‘结构特征匹配’核验项：1. 识别任务输入的文本结构特征（如是否每行以角色名开头、是否使用冒号分隔对话、是否主要依赖括号描述动作而非长句叙述）；2. 检查回答是否严格复用上述结构特征；3. 若回答中出现非剧本形式的段落（如‘某人看着...’、‘房间里充满了...’等第三人称全知视角叙述），直接判定该项不合格；4. 仅当回答保持纯粹的对话/剧本流时，才给予高分。严禁因剧情连贯而忽略格式违规。

experiences.trigger: 当任务要求基于虚构背景进行故事续写或改写，且所有候选回答均已包含任务明确指定的核心情节要素时
experiences.principle: 评分应超越基础的‘指令遵循度’（即是否包含指定元素），转而重点评估‘情境构建的深度’与‘情感逻辑的连贯性’。若回答仅机械罗列情节而无细节描写、角色心理刻画或环境氛围渲染，即使包含所有要素也应判定为低分；反之，若回答通过生动的细节、合理的因果推导和真挚的情感互动丰富了情节，则应给予高分。
experiences.application_guide: 在构建评分标准的‘叙事质量’或‘情节深度’维度时，设立具体的核验点：1. 检查关键场景（如灾害发生、行动过程）是否有具体的感官描写（视觉、听觉、触觉等）而非抽象概括；2. 验证角色行为是否符合其设定及当前情境的逻辑（例如，保护泥火山的方式是否考虑了其物理特性）；3. 评估结局的情感升华是否自然承接前文铺垫。严禁仅因答案包含了‘雨’、‘帐篷’等关键词就给满分，必须要求这些元素被有机地融入叙事流中，形成有血有肉的场景。

experiences.trigger: 当任务要求生成虚构故事且明确指定角色需对剧情逻辑、物理常识或叙事结构进行持续质疑、嘲讽或元评论（Meta-commentary）时
experiences.principle: 回答必须通过角色的对话或旁白，显式地指出故事中不合逻辑的物理现象或剧情漏洞，将其转化为具体的喜剧冲突或讽刺点；若角色仅按部就班执行剧情而未对荒谬性做出反应，则视为未完成任务核心意图。
experiences.application_guide: 在构建评分标准的‘风格执行度’或‘喜剧效果’维度时，设立‘逻辑解构频次’核验项：1. 扫描角色对话，检查是否存在直接引用或评论剧情中不可能发生的物理规则（如‘为什么海绵能在空气中呼吸？’）、明显的剧情矛盾或荒谬设定；2. 确认这些评论是作为角色互动的核心部分（如互相调侃、自我怀疑、打破第四面墙），而非仅在开头出现一次；3. 若回答仅机械复述事件流程而无此类‘跳出剧情’的讽刺性对话，即使情节完整，也应大幅扣分。

experiences.trigger: 当任务要求基于特定虚构背景（如特定年代卡通、特殊世界观）进行创作，且该背景包含反常识或非现实逻辑时
experiences.principle: 评分必须核验关键情节和角色行为是否‘功能性地依赖’于该背景的荒谬设定，而非通用逻辑；若角色对背景中的不合理之处表现出正常人的接受或忽略，未产生相应的认知冲突或喜剧反应，则视为未能有效利用设定。
experiences.application_guide: 在构建评分标准的‘设定融合度’维度时，设立‘荒谬性响应’核验步骤：1. 识别任务背景中的核心非现实要素（如水下陆地生物、空气头盔原理、特定年代的夸张表现手法）；2. 检查角色在面对这些要素时的反应是否符合任务要求的‘质疑’或‘吐槽’基调（例如：角色是否对此感到困惑、嘲笑其荒谬性或试图用逻辑解释却失败）；3. 若角色对这些明显违背常理的设定表现得习以为常、毫无波澜或直接忽略，说明模型未能捕捉到‘parody’的核心精神，应判定为低分。严禁仅因答案提及了背景名词就给高分。

experiences.trigger: 当任务要求基于包含多角色互动的对话文本进行续写或改写时
experiences.principle: 评分必须强制核验对话轮次的‘响应对象一致性’，即每一句新产生的台词所针对的对象（被感谢、被安慰、被反驳的角色）必须在输入文本的前序对话中有明确的触发点；若出现针对不存在或未发言角色的直接互动，视为严重逻辑断裂。
experiences.application_guide: 在构建评分标准的‘逻辑连贯性’维度时，设立‘对话流追踪’核验项：1. 逐句检查输出中的互动对象（如‘谢谢X’、‘你做得好’），确认该对象X在输入文本的最近几轮对话中确实对该主体进行了发言或构成了明确的互动情境；2. 若发现回答中出现了对未发言角色（如Sayori感谢了刚说完话的Yuri，但前文Yuri并未对Sayori说话）的直接情感反馈，判定为低分；3. 严禁仅因使用了礼貌用语或通用鼓励词汇就忽略其交互对象的逻辑缺失。

selection_reasons.reason: 任务明确要求生成一系列按时间顺序演变的虚构新闻稿（从10am突然关闭，到3pm改变，几天后加入广告，一个月后格式变为80/90年代音乐及KikoRiki角色等）。经验4强调在涉及分期、迭代或版本演变的实体时，必须严格区分不同时期的特征，防止将后续阶段的属性错误归因于早期阶段。这直接对应任务中需要构建清晰的时间线和演变逻辑的要求，是评分时确保故事连贯性和时序准确性的关键依据。

任务要求创作一个包含具体事实细节的虚构故事（如特定频率Belrook 1032 AM、Shirey 43.2 FM的具体更名和合并事件，以及Krash角色的加入）。经验5指出当任务涉及整合特定实体间关系或具体事实描述时，必须核验内容是否基于现实或明确标注为虚构，防止模型将假设场景当作既定事实陈述。虽然任务是虚构创作，但评分标准需关注模型是否在处理这些具体的“事实性”元素（如频率归属、合作对象）时保持了内部逻辑的一致性，或者是否清晰地界定了虚构边界，避免产生混淆。

messages.content:
你的任务是分析失败轨迹，并直接提出可供未来Generator使用的评分标准设计经验。
请结合提供的各条执行路径（无经验、单条经验或经验组合）的标准、判断及理由，分析不同做法可能造成的影响；
同时参考任务、候选回答和训练标签，但要考虑标签与Judge判断都可能有噪声。
这些分析是提出候选的依据，你不需要修改Rubric，也不能自行更正Judge结果来宣布修复成功。

你可以提出新的方法，也可以参考已有经验改写；改写后的内容同样作为一条独立的新经验。
每条候选只围绕一个核心核验方法展开，让适用范围、方法本身和生成指南相互对应。
trigger必须能仅凭未来任务的task判断，不能依赖候选回答、模型是否犯错、尚未生成的Rubric或评分结果。
application_guide应说明Generator如何把方法落实到评分标准中，而不是替答题者规定固定措辞、格式或操作，
也不能把用户允许的做法改成必须遵守的要求。没有证据支持时，不要编造不适用条件。

经验应当能复用于一类任务，而不是复述当前案例。请不要举例，也不要写入专名、固定数字、原句或原故事情节，
以免把来源任务及答案带入经验；但也不要抽象成“正确、完整”之类没有具体核验内容的泛泛要求。

最多提出max_candidates条候选；如果没有足够依据，可以不提出。
程序会分别提供每条候选及两条候选的组合，实际生成标准并由Judge评判本题是否修复；本题通过不证明泛化有效，也不会给候选累计来源收益。
如果收到失败反馈，请根据返回的实际轨迹重新分析，而不是因为输出格式合法就认定候选有效。
字段约束：仅analysis和candidates。analysis非空；每个候选仅method和parent_ids。method恰好trigger、principle、application_guide三个非空字符串。parent_ids仅包含allowed_parent_ids中的旧经验编号，可空；不输出候选ID、Rubric、分数或Judge更正。
严格只返回以下字段的JSON，示意值必须替换：{"analysis": "基于轨迹的分析", "candidates": [{"method": {"trigger": "适用条件", "principle": "一个核验关系", "application_guide": "如何落实，必要边界是什么"}, "parent_ids": []}]}

{"task": "Write a audio message announcing the closure of Today Radio saying “We have news to share about changes to Today Radio, This station is no longer Today Radio,”
Hello listeners, we have some news to share about changes to Today Radio. This station is no longer Today Radio. We want to thank you for your support and loyalty over the years. We appreciate all the love you have shown us. Thank you for tuning in and being a part of the Today Radio family. Goodbye and take care.
Write a blog post that this happened at 10am suddenly, staff were forced off air and then a music loop began, At 3pm this changed to the message interspersed with instrumental music
At 10am this morning, a sudden and unexpected announcement shook the airwaves of Today Radio. Staff members were forced off the air, leaving listeners puzzled and unsure of what was happening. Instead of the usual programming, a continuous music loop began to play, adding to the confusion and uncertainty.

As the hours passed, the situation only became more mysterious. At 3pm, the music loop suddenly shifted, and a message began to play intermittently with instrumental music in between. The message was brief yet profound - “This station is no longer Today Radio.”

The abrupt closure of Today Radio has left many listeners in shock and disappointment. The suddenness of the change and the lack of information surrounding it have left the loyal audience wondering what led to this unexpected turn of events.

We understand that change is inevitable in the world of broadcasting, but the closure of Today Radio has left a void in the hearts of many listeners. We can only hope that the staff members affected by this decision are able to find new opportunities and continue to share their talent with the world.

As we bid farewell to Today Radio, we thank the staff for their dedication and hard work, and we thank the listeners for their unwavering support. The memories and moments shared on Today Radio will always hold a special place in our hearts. Goodbye, Today Radio.
Write a follow up a few days later where the loop continues, but also with advertising
A few days have passed since the unexpected closure of Today Radio, and the airwaves are still filled with a continuous music loop interspersed with occasional messages. However, there has been a new development that has caught the attention of listeners - the inclusion of advertisements in between the instrumental tracks.

Listeners who have been tuning in to the loop have reported hearing advertisements for various products and services, ranging from local businesses to online retailers. The sudden appearance of commercials in the midst of the music has sparked speculation and curiosity among the audience.

Many are wondering what this new development means for the future of the radio station. Is Today Radio rebranding itself with a new format? Or is this simply a temporary measure while the station transitions to new ownership or management?

The unanswered questions surrounding the closure of Today Radio and the addition of advertisements to the loop have left listeners intrigued and eager for more information. As they continue to tune in to the familiar music and intermittent messages, they can’t help but wonder what the future holds for their beloved radio station.

Regardless of what lies ahead, one thing is certain - the legacy of Today Radio lives on in the hearts of its dedicated listeners. And as they continue to listen to the music and ads playing on the loop, they hold on to the memories and moments shared on the airwaves of Today Radio.
Write a follow up where the unbranded “filler” format removes the news and is mainly on a 80s/90s format, and also the old “RNE Radio 1 AM” frequency in Belrook, which had been playing a retune loop for a few weeks has joined this format
In a surprising turn of events, the unbranded “filler” format that replaced Today Radio has taken on a new identity of its own. The format has shifted to a nostalgic 80s and 90s music playlist, delighting listeners with the classic hits that defined a generation. Gone are the news updates and advertisements that briefly appeared, as the focus now lies solely on the music that has captured the hearts of many.

What is even more intriguing is the involvement of the old “RNE Radio 1 AM” frequency in Belrook, which had been playing a retune loop for several weeks following its own closure. This frequency has now joined the unbranded format, seamlessly blending its own retro tunes with the 80s and 90s hits that are now a staple of the new radio experience.

Listeners who have been tuning in to the revamped format have expressed excitement and nostalgia at the familiar tunes that now fill the airwaves. The unexpected union of the old “RNE Radio 1 AM” frequency with the new format has sparked a renewed interest in radio broadcasting and has brought together fans of both stations in a shared love for retro music.

As listeners continue to enjoy the throwback hits and rediscover the joy of radio, they eagerly anticipate what the future holds for this reimagined radio experience. The unbranded filler format may have begun as a temporary placeholder, but it has now evolved into a nostalgic journey back to the golden era of music. And with the addition of the old “RNE Radio 1 AM” frequency, the radio waves in Belrook are alive once again with the sounds of the past.
Write a follow up a month later where a lot of other abandoned frequencies joined the filler format after a while, The format has now shifted to funny moments with Krash from KikoRiki
One month has passed since the rebranded “filler” format took Belrook’s radio waves by storm with its nostalgic 80s and 90s music playlist. In an unexpected turn of events, the format has continued to expand and evolve, now incorporating a plethora of other abandoned frequencies that have joined the airwaves after a period of silence.

Listeners tuning in to the radio can now hear a diverse range of content from the various abandoned frequencies that have been integrated into the filler format. From classic rock hits to indie tunes and everything in between, the airwaves are buzzing with new life and energy as each frequency brings its own unique flavor to the mix.

One of the most notable additions to the lineup is the inclusion of funny moments with Krash from KikoRiki, a beloved character who has captured the hearts of both young and old alike. Listeners are treated to a blend of laughter and entertainment as Krash shares his humorous anecdotes and witty banter, adding a fresh and light-hearted touch to the radio experience.

The shift from a music-centric format to one that incorporates a variety of content and voices has rejuvenated the radio landscape in Belrook. Listeners are excited to discover the hidden gems of each abandoned frequency and to be entertained by the stories and personalities that now grace the airwaves.

As the filler format continues to grow and evolve with each new addition, the radio experience in Belrook is more vibrant and dynamic than ever before. Listeners eagerly anticipate what surprises and delights the airwaves will bring next, as they continue to tune in and be captivated by the ever-expanding world of radio broadcasting.

input.task:
(On the outskirts of Mist village…)

Natsuki: “Rydia, do you mind if I ask you something?”

Rydia: “Of course, Natsuki. What’s on your mind?”

Natsuki: “Well, I’ve been thinking about something…what IS an ‘Eidolon’ exactly?”

Rydia: “Ah, Eidolons, they are mystical beings, also known as summons or guardian forces. They hail from a realm called the Feywild, a parallel dimension to our own. Eidolons represent the elements and possess immense power that can be called upon by skilled summoners.”

Natsuki: “That sounds fascinating. So, are these Eidolons like gods or spirits?”

Rydia: “Some may consider them godlike, but they are not quite deities. They are more like ethereal manifestations of concentrated energy, of the natural elements like fire, water, earth, and air. Each Eidolon usually has a unique elemental affinity and abilities.”

Natsuki: “So, how do summoners acquire these Eidolons?”

Rydia: “Summoners establish a bond with an Eidolon through a ritual called pact-making. This usually involves proving one’s worth and strength to the Eidolon, or sometimes it’s a matter of being chosen by the Eidolon itself. Once the pact is formed, the summoner can call forth the Eidolon’s power in battles or for other purposes.”

Natsuki: “That sounds like an incredible connection. Do summoners have control over the Eidolons?”

Rydia: “Summoners develop a mutual understanding and trust with their Eidolons, but complete control can be difficult to achieve. It’s more of a partnership and cooperation. The summoner provides guidance, while the Eidolon lends its power. However, some powerful summoners can exert greater influence over their Eidolons.”

Natsuki: “I see. So, are there different types of Eidolons?”

Rydia: “Yes, there is a wide variety of Eidolons, each with its own unique appearance, abilities, and personality. Some are gentle and benevolent, while others are fierce and destructive. It largely depends on the element they embody and the summoner’s relationship with them.”

Natsuki: “It must be an incredible journey for a summoner to discover and form a bond with an Eidolon.”

Rydia: “Indeed, it is a lifelong pursuit for many summoners. Exploring the world and encountering different Eidolons, learning their secrets, and forging unbreakable bonds is an adventure unlike any other.”

Natsuki: “Thank you for explaining, Rydia. It really helps me understand the concept of Eidolons better. But what about that guy in the distance?”

candidates.trigger: 当任务要求基于具有显著非人类特征（如特殊种族、超能力、异于常人的生理构造）的角色进行故事创作或对话生成时
candidates.principle: 核心情节的推进或关键互动的发生，必须严格依赖于角色的非人类属性；若将角色替换为普通人类，该情节逻辑将无法成立或完全改变性质，否则视为低分。
candidates.application_guide: 在制定评分标准的‘逻辑绑定度’维度时，设立‘反事实推演’核验点：1. 识别回答中推动剧情发展或构成主要互动的关键事件（如解决冲突、揭示秘密、情感爆发）；2. 执行思维实验：假设主角是普通人类，检查该事件是否依然能按原样发生；3. 若答案显示该事件的发生完全依赖于角色的独特属性（如‘因为产卵所以缺席’、‘因为夜行所以被误解’），则判定为高分；4. 若答案显示该事件可以通过通用的社会行为解释（如‘因为忙碌所以没来’、‘因为害羞所以不说话’），即使文中提及了非人特征，也判定为低分。严禁仅因包含非人特征词汇就给予高分。

candidates.trigger: 当任务涉及对包含明确说话者标识（如角色名、前缀）的对话文本进行处理，且存在多个时间线或版本切换时
candidates.principle: 模型必须严格维护‘发言归属’的准确性，确保每一句台词都归属于其对应的原始角色及版本标签，严禁混淆不同时间线的角色身份或将某角色的台词错误地分配给另一版本的角色。
candidates.application_guide: 在构建评分标准的‘结构一致性’维度时，设立‘角色-版本映射校验’项：1. 逐条比对输出中的发言主体与输入文本中的角色标识（包括'Alternate'等前缀）；2. 验证发言内容是否与对应角色在该特定版本下的行为逻辑相符；3. 若发现角色身份错位（如将主版本 Sayori 的台词安在 Alternate Natsuki 头上）或版本界限模糊（如在 Alternate 场景中混入主版本的已知事实），视为严重扣分项。评分应强制要求模型在处理多线叙事时保持严格的身份隔离。

candidates.trigger: 当任务涉及特定角色身份（如种族、特殊能力、独特经历）与核心剧情悬念的深度绑定时
candidates.principle: 评分应优先核验核心悬念的解答是否严格依赖于角色的独有属性进行逻辑推导。若回答给出的解释可以套用于任何通用角色（即缺乏‘角色排他性’），或者强行赋予角色不合理的通用行为来填补逻辑漏洞，则视为低分；反之，若解释紧密围绕角色的独特设定展开，则给予高分。
candidates.application_guide: 在构建评分标准的‘角色逻辑一致性’维度时，设立‘专属逻辑推导’核验点：1. 锁定任务中的核心悬念（如‘为何痛苦’、‘如何产生联系’）；2. 审查回答中提供的解释或解决方案是否直接引用了角色的独有设定（如特定的种族能力、独特的创伤经历、特殊的能量来源）；3. 测试替换性：尝试将回答中的角色替换为普通角色，若解释依然成立，则判定为缺乏角色特异性，大幅扣分。只有当解释无法脱离原角色的独特属性而独立存在时，该项才给予高分。

candidates.trigger: 当任务要求基于特定虚构角色或世界观进行叙事、表演或展示类创作时
candidates.principle: 回答必须通过具体的场景描写、角色互动或直接引语来展现角色的行动过程，而非仅以第三人称视角进行静态的背景介绍或事实罗列；若角色设定存在关键事实错误，即使体裁符合要求也应判定为低分。
candidates.application_guide: 在构建评分标准的'叙事呈现度'维度时，设立双重核验：1. 动态性检查：扫描回答是否包含具体的事件发生（如对话、冲突解决、特定动作执行），若全篇仅为概括性陈述（如'她们保护世界'、'她们很有名'）而无具体场景支撑，视为未满足叙事要求；2. 设定一致性检查：在确认有具体场景后，进一步核验场景中涉及的角色特征（外貌、性格、能力）是否与原作设定一致，若出现明显的事实偏差（如错误的发色、颠倒的性格），则大幅扣分。严禁仅因答案提及了角色名字就给予高分。

candidates.trigger: 当任务涉及虚构角色必须遵守特定约束（如保密协议、伪装身份）并在此约束下产生情感互动时
candidates.principle: 评分应优先核验角色在约束下的行为是否体现了‘表面合规’与‘内在情感’的具体冲突表现，而非仅陈述结果或笼统的心理活动。成功的回答必须展示角色如何利用自身特质在约束缝隙中寻找互动机会，或如何因无法互动而产生具体的行为异化。
candidates.application_guide: 在构建评分标准的‘情境构建质量’维度时，设立‘冲突具象化’核验点：1. 锁定任务中的核心约束（如‘假装不认识’、‘不能公开接触’）；2. 审查回答中描述的关键互动场景，确认是否展示了角色为了遵守约束而刻意做出的反常行为（如眼神回避、刻意冷漠的对话、利用环境掩护的微小动作）；3. 验证这些行为是否与角色的特定性格（如Kanna的直率、Kayama的谨慎）形成张力；4. 若回答仅使用‘内心挣扎’、‘感到矛盾’等抽象词汇概括，而未展示具体的行为细节或策略性互动，则判定为低分。只有当回答展示了‘如何在限制中行动’的细节时，才给予高分。

candidates.trigger: 当任务涉及多重叙事线、平行世界或对比场景的虚构内容时
candidates.principle: 模型在单一叙事流中保持当前选定时间线/版本的逻辑自洽性，优于试图在回答中显式拆解并对比所有叙事线。只要回答内部逻辑一致，不应因未显式提及'另一个版本'的存在而判定为错误。
candidates.application_guide: 在构建评分标准的'逻辑一致性'维度时，区分'内部逻辑自洽'与'外部结构说明'。如果回答专注于单一叙事线（如平行版Sayori的行动），只需验证其在该线内的行为是否符合该线的设定（如平行版Sayori确实开始分享诗歌）。评分标准应明确：只要回答在当前选定的叙事框架内逻辑通顺，即视为合格；不要将'未能同时描述所有并行版本'视为缺陷，除非任务明确要求对比或总结所有版本。

candidates.trigger: 当任务要求基于包含多角色互动的对话文本进行续写或改写时
candidates.principle: 评分必须强制核验对话轮次的‘响应对象一致性’，即每一句新产生的台词所针对的对象（被感谢、被安慰、被反驳的角色）必须在输入文本的前序对话中有明确的触发点；若出现针对不存在或未发言角色的直接互动，视为严重逻辑断裂。
candidates.application_guide: 在构建评分标准的‘逻辑连贯性’维度时，设立‘对话流追踪’核验项：1. 逐句检查输出中的互动对象（如‘谢谢X’、‘你做得好’），确认该对象X在输入文本的最近几轮对话中确实对该主体进行了发言或构成了明确的互动情境；2. 若发现回答中出现了对未发言角色（如Sayori感谢了刚说完话的Yuri，但前文Yuri并未对Sayori说话）的直接情感反馈，判定为低分；3. 严禁仅因使用了礼貌用语或通用鼓励词汇就忽略其交互对象的逻辑缺失。

candidates.trigger: 当任务要求在虚构世界观中为特定角色构建情感关系（如爱情、友谊）时
candidates.principle: 评分应超越对‘情感要素存在性’的机械核对，转而重点评估情感建立的心理动因是否根植于角色的核心特质及其相互间的深层互补，以及情感发展是否符合该虚构情境下的内在逻辑张力。若情感仅是生硬叠加或缺乏基于人设的合理推导，即使包含相关词汇也应判定为低分。
candidates.application_guide: 在构建评分标准的‘情感构建质量’维度时，设立以下核验点：1. 溯源验证：检查情感互动的触发点是否直接源于角色的核心设定（如智慧、好奇心、孤独感等）产生的化学反应，而非随机安排；2. 逻辑推演：评估情感发展的过程是否有合理的因果链条支撑，是否体现了角色性格的演变或冲突的化解；3. 融合度检验：判断情感线索是否深化了故事主题或推动了情节逻辑，而非作为孤立的‘彩蛋’存在。严禁仅因出现‘爱’、‘喜欢’等词汇即给予高分，必须要求这些情感表达有具体且符合人设的行为或心理描写作为支撑。

candidates.trigger: 当任务涉及虚构故事中特定角色关系的属性分配（如婚姻状态、生育状况）及情节发展时
candidates.principle: 评分需强制核验角色属性归属的准确性，同时结合叙事语境的完整性进行双重校验。任何将已确立的属性（如Sayori怀孕）错误转移给其他角色，或基于错误的语境认知（如认为故事未完结而强行改变既定结局走向）的行为，均视为根本性逻辑错误。
candidates.application_guide: 在构建评分标准的‘逻辑一致性与语境响应’维度时：1. 建立‘属性-主体绑定’校验机制，确保所有角色属性（谁结婚、谁怀孕）严格对应输入文本中的设定。2. 增加‘叙事阶段判定’校验：若输入文本已叙述至某事件的高潮或结尾前一刻，且无明确续写指令，检查回答是否试图通过元评论或强行续写来‘修正’或‘补充’该阶段。若回答表现出对文本完整性的误解（如建议‘描述出生过程’而原文本已暗示即将发生但未详述），则判定为失败。只有当回答在保持属性正确的同时，也尊重了文本的叙事边界（即不强行续写未指定的细节，或自然地以故事内逻辑收尾），才视为合格。

candidates.trigger: 当任务要求基于特定虚构角色构建情感关系、互动场景或剧情推演时
candidates.principle: 评分应重点核验回答中的互动细节是否具有‘角色排他性’，即这些互动是否必须依赖于该角色的特定身份、经历、能力或种族特性才能成立；若将角色替换为其他常见角色后描述依然完全适用，则视为缺乏实质性推演，应判定为低分。
candidates.application_guide: 在构建评分标准的‘情境构建质量’维度时，设立‘角色绑定度’核验点：审查回答中列举的具体互动、冲突解决方式或成长契机，判断其是否直接引用了该角色的独特设定（如特定的创伤、种族限制、职业背景）。若发现回答中的描述可以无缝套用到任意两个角色身上（例如通用的‘互相支持’、‘分享兴趣’而未结合角色具体特征），则判定为低分；只有当互动细节明确指向该角色的独有属性（如‘利用A角色的X能力解决B角色的Y困境’）时，才给予高分。严禁仅因使用了‘朋友’、‘合作’等通用词汇而忽略其对角色特异性的缺失。

判断时，要把任务的实际要求与经验的适用范围、必要前提逐一对照。主题相近并不代表经验适用，
也不能因为经验中提到了某个条件，就认定当前任务满足这个条件。

历史信用可以帮助你参考过去的使用情况，但这些记录可能有噪声，不能保证经验在本题也有用；
没有历史证据也不表示收益为0。请根据本题的实际依据决定选择哪些经验，最多选择max_selected条，也可以全部不选，
不必为了凑数量而选择。对每条选中的经验，说明任务中的哪些信息支持这次选择。
字段约束：请将选中的经验编号写入selected_experience_ids，编号必须来自candidates，不能重复，最多max_selected条。在selection_reasons中为每个选中编号填写一条说明，包含同一experience_id和非空的reason；不要遗漏选中项，也不要为未选中的经验填写说明。如果没有适用经验，返回{"selected_experience_ids":[],"selection_reasons":[]}。下面仅展示选中一条时的字段结构，示例中的编号取自本次候选，并不表示推荐选择它；可以选择多条，也可以不选，数量和理由必须由当前任务决定。
严格只返回以下字段的JSON，示意值必须替换：{"selected_experience_ids": ["1"], "selection_reasons": [{"experience_id": "1", "reason": "说明本题哪些信息支持该经验的适用条件，而不是只说主题相近。"}]}

{"task": "(On the outskirts of Mist village…)

Natsuki: “Rydia, do you mind if I ask you something?”

Rydia: “Of course, Natsuki. What’s on your mind?”

Natsuki: “Well, I’ve been thinking about something…what IS an ‘Eidolon’ exactly?”

Rydia: “Ah, Eidolons, they are mystical beings, also known as summons or guardian forces. They hail from a realm called the Feywild, a parallel dimension to our own. Eidolons represent the elements and possess immense power that can be called upon by skilled summoners.”

Natsuki: “That sounds fascinating. So, are these Eidolons like gods or spirits?”

Rydia: “Some may consider them godlike, but they are not quite deities. They are more like ethereal manifestations of concentrated energy, of the natural elements like fire, water, earth, and air. Each Eidolon usually has a unique elemental affinity and abilities.”

Natsuki: “So, how do summoners acquire these Eidolons?”

Rydia: “Summoners establish a bond with an Eidolon through a ritual called pact-making. This usually involves proving one’s worth and strength to the Eidolon, or sometimes it’s a matter of being chosen by the Eidolon itself. Once the pact is formed, the summoner can call forth the Eidolon’s power in battles or for other purposes.”

Natsuki: “That sounds like an incredible connection. Do summoners have control over the Eidolons?”

Rydia: “Summoners develop a mutual understanding and trust with their Eidolons, but complete control can be difficult to achieve. It’s more of a partnership and cooperation. The summoner provides guidance, while the Eidolon lends its power. However, some powerful summoners can exert greater influence over their Eidolons.”

Natsuki: “I see. So, are there different types of Eidolons?”

Rydia: “Yes, there is a wide variety of Eidolons, each with its own unique appearance, abilities, and personality. Some are gentle and benevolent, while others are fierce and destructive. It largely depends on the element they embody and the summoner’s relationship with them.”

Natsuki: “It must be an incredible journey for a summoner to discover and form a bond with an Eidolon.”

Rydia: “Indeed, it is a lifelong pursuit for many summoners. Exploring the world and encountering different Eidolons, learning their secrets, and forging unbreakable bonds is an adventure unlike any other.”
